fullTextZH: 今天我想跟大家聊一聊,
fullTextEN: Today I want to chat with everyone,
about one of my students.
I just finished a class with her.

fullTextZH: 我问她你最近的学习怎么样？
fullTextEN: I asked her how her recent studies are going.
She said not very well.

fullTextZH: 以前她感觉自己的词汇量越来越大，
fullTextEN: Previously, she felt her vocabulary was growing,
able to speak more and more,
and she was making progress.
Recently, she's been practicing pronunciation,
and she feels terrible,
unable to sense her progress,

fullTextZH: 觉得自己怎么练习都学不会。
fullTextEN: feeling like no matter how she practices, she can't learn.

fullTextZH: 所以我觉得她肯定不是一个人，
fullTextEN: So I think she's definitely not alone,

fullTextZH: 肯定有别的学生也有这样的问题。
fullTextEN: there must be other students with the same problem.

fullTextZH: 所以我想跟大家说一说，
fullTextEN: So I want to talk to everyone about,
my perspective.

fullTextZH: 这个学生问了我两个很好的问题，
fullTextEN: This student asked me two very good questions,

fullTextZH: 第一个是她练习发音的时候，
fullTextEN: The first is when she practices pronunciation,

fullTextZH: 她觉得她什么都做不了。
fullTextEN: she feels she can't do anything.
She can only practice pronunciation,

fullTextZH: 不想管其他方面的学习了。
fullTextEN: I don't want to manage other aspects of learning anymore.
For example, vocabulary,
listening to things,
she is not doing any of it.
The second question,
is related to this question,

fullTextZH: 她想问我为什么会这样子，
fullTextEN: she wants to ask me why this is happening,
why she focuses on pronunciation,
and then she forgets everything.
And it's not that she doesn't want to,
it's that she feels she can't do it,

fullTextZH: 没有能力做这么多事情。
fullTextEN: she doesn't have the ability to do so many things.
Today I want to answer,
this is my explanation to him.
When learning a language,

fullTextZH: 我们的注意力是很分散的。
fullTextEN: our attention is very scattered.

fullTextZH: 这个饼就是我们的注意力，，
fullTextEN: This pie represents our attention,
we pay attention to many things,
we need to practice listening,
practice our speaking,
When speaking,
you also need to pay attention to pronunciation,
and also tones, right?
You also need to learn vocabulary,
increase vocabulary size,
and also speak correctly,

fullTextZH: 那我们要说好这个句子结构。
fullTextEN: then we need to master sentence structure.

fullTextZH: 有些人还要练这个汉字，
fullTextEN: Some people also need to practice Chinese characters,

fullTextZH: 你看我们的注意力就是这样分散。
fullTextEN: You see, our attention is just so scattered.
You can imagine,
juggling so many things at once,
what will the result be?
I gave her a metaphor,

fullTextZH: 其实就像你想同时做很多份工作，
fullTextEN: It's like you want to do many jobs at once,
You want to be a lawyer,
a doctor, a teacher,
run a pizza shop,

fullTextZH: 但是每个人的注意力只有100%，
fullTextEN: but everyone's attention is only 100%,

fullTextZH: 然后你20%的精力去当医生，
fullTextEN: then you use 20% of your energy to be a doctor,
20% of your energy to run a pizza shop,
20% of the energy to be a lawyer,

fullTextZH: 如果你只是用一部分的注意力，
fullTextEN: If you only use part of your attention,
to learn it,
You learn a little bit of medicine,
a little bit of law,
How would the effect be if you learn them at the same time?

fullTextZH: 结果就是你什么都做不了，
fullTextEN: The result is you can't do anything,
You know a little bit of this,
a little bit of that,

fullTextZH: 你感受不到自己的进步，
fullTextEN: You can't feel your own progress,
Then you will also start to doubt,
Am I really stupid,
I am such a failure,
Isn't it like this.

fullTextZH: 然后我又画了这个给她看，
fullTextEN: Then I drew this again to show her,

fullTextZH: 假设这个是他100%的注意力，
fullTextEN: Assume this is his 100% attention,
80% of the energy,

fullTextZH: 她放在口语听力和词汇上，
fullTextEN: She puts it on speaking, listening, and vocabulary,

fullTextZH: 口语和听力是很接近的嘛，
fullTextEN: Speaking and listening are very close, right,

fullTextZH: 或者就是80%放在听力和词汇上，
fullTextEN: Or just 80% on listening and vocabulary,
20% of your energy to do other things,
It's not that you don't practice pronunciation,

fullTextZH: 但是有限的精力去做它。
fullTextEN: but limited energy to do it.

fullTextZH: 这样地去分配自己的精力，
fullTextEN: Distribute your energy like this,
How do you feel,
isn't it much healthier?
But you might think,
Pronunciation is also very important,

fullTextZH: 我想要别人能听懂我说什么，
fullTextEN: I want others to understand what I say,
Why don't I put 80% of my energy,

fullTextZH: 或者100%的精力去练习发音呢。
fullTextEN: or 100% of my energy into practicing pronunciation.

fullTextZH: 我觉得这里没有准确的答案，
fullTextEN: I think there's no exact answer here,

fullTextZH: 我认为最重要的问题就是，
fullTextEN: I believe the most important question is,

fullTextZH: 你学语言的终极目标是什么？
fullTextEN: What is your ultimate goal in learning a language?
Do you want to communicate with people,
make friends and build connections,

fullTextZH: 跟你的中国的家人聊天呢，
fullTextEN: chat with your Chinese family,
or is there another reason,

fullTextZH: 所以要看你的终极目标。
fullTextEN: so you need to look at your ultimate goal.
I believe those of you watching the video,

fullTextZH: 绝大部分的人会告诉我，
fullTextEN: The vast majority of people will tell me,
You want to build more connections,

fullTextZH: 想要跟人用中文无障碍地交流，
fullTextEN: You want to communicate with people in Chinese without barriers,

fullTextZH: 那这个就是你的终极目标。
fullTextEN: Then this is your ultimate goal.

fullTextZH: 那你可能需要问自己的问题是，
fullTextEN: Then the question you might need to ask yourself is,

fullTextZH: 如果你的发音不是100%标准，
fullTextEN: If your pronunciation is not 100% standard,

fullTextZH: 你可以做到你的终极目标吗？
fullTextEN: Can you achieve your ultimate goal?
I believe it's possible.

fullTextZH: 我想跟你说一说我的故事，
fullTextEN: I want to tell you my story,
In the past when studying,

fullTextZH: 西班牙语和英语的时候，
fullTextEN: When learning Spanish and English,
I was also very focused on pronunciation.
When I was studying for my master's,
There were 40 students in the class,
From more than 20 countries,

fullTextZH: 所以你会听到各种各样不同的口音。
fullTextEN: So you would hear all kinds of different accents.
I started to observe,

fullTextZH: 我当时以为我的发音很好，
fullTextEN: I thought my pronunciation was good at the time,

fullTextZH: 那我可以交到更多的朋友，
fullTextEN: Then I could make more friends,

fullTextZH: 我可以跟他们更好地交流。
fullTextEN: I could communicate better with them.
But I found that some students,

fullTextZH: 他的英语其实并没有那么好，
fullTextEN: His English is actually not that good,
His pronunciation is also not very standard.

fullTextZH: 但是他们可以很真实地表达自己，
fullTextEN: But they can express themselves very genuinely,

fullTextZH: 反而我觉得这些人非常有魅力，
fullTextEN: Instead, I find these people very charming,
I really want to be friends with them.
At that time, I realized,

fullTextZH: 发音不一定要这么完美，
fullTextEN: Pronunciation doesn't have to be so perfect,
Then I had an epiphany.

fullTextZH: 这么多年我一直在专注自己的发音，
fullTextEN: For so many years, I have been focusing on my pronunciation,
which might not be so necessary.

fullTextZH: 语言就是一个交流的工具，
fullTextEN: Language is just a tool for communication,

fullTextZH: 如果可以互相交流就可以了，
fullTextEN: If we can communicate with each other, that's enough,
Moreover, my view is that,

fullTextZH: 发音是随着时间不断改进的。
fullTextEN: Pronunciation improves continuously over time.
For example,

fullTextZH: 一开始我学习西班牙语和英语的时候，
fullTextEN: When I first started learning Spanish and English,

fullTextZH: 我是有很强烈的中文口音的。
fullTextEN: I had a very strong Chinese accent.
But over time,
I kept listening,

fullTextZH: 不断地发现自己的发音的小错误，
fullTextEN: Constantly discovering small pronunciation mistakes,

fullTextZH: 一点一点一点点的进步，
fullTextEN: Making progress little by little,

fullTextZH: 到现在我的口语就更接近母语者了。
fullTextEN: Now my speaking is closer to a native speaker.
So why do so many students,
pay so much attention to pronunciation?
Many students tell me,
they have a perfectionism,

fullTextZH: 就是一定要说准确再开口，
fullTextEN: that is, they must speak accurately before speaking,
including this student of mine.
She told me,

fullTextZH: 我真得很害怕别人听不懂，
fullTextEN: I'm really afraid others won't understand,
it's too embarrassing.

fullTextZH: 嗯，以前我说一个很简单的东西，
fullTextEN: Hmm, before when I said something very simple,
they couldn't understand,
then I asked her:
"When did this happen?"

fullTextZH: "是最近的事情还是以前的事情"。
fullTextEN: "Was it recent or a long time ago?"

fullTextZH: 她就说很久以前的事情。
fullTextEN: She said it was a long time ago.
We all do this,

fullTextZH: 因为以前一些不太舒服的一个经历，
fullTextEN: because of some uncomfortable past experience,
This leads to being especially afraid now.

fullTextZH: 很多人就特别害怕发音不标准，
fullTextEN: Many people are especially afraid of incorrect pronunciation,

fullTextZH: 但是她现在已经是另外一个人了，
fullTextEN: But she is already a different person now,

fullTextZH: 每天她都是不一样的人，
fullTextEN: Every day she is a different person,

fullTextZH: 她每天都在进步一点点，
fullTextEN: She makes a little progress every day,

fullTextZH: 现在的她跟以前不一样了。
fullTextEN: She is now different from before.
So as long as there is continuous progress,
Her pronunciation will get better and better.

fullTextZH: 如果她可以重点练习听力，
fullTextEN: If she can focus on practicing listening,
or speaking,
it will be more helpful for her.

fullTextZH: 这就是我今天想跟大家分享的东西，
fullTextEN: This is what I want to share with everyone today,
I hope it helps you,
Leave a message to tell me, see you next time.
